items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.why: It introduces Google's latest fast LLM model release that you can test and integrate into your software projects.
items.summary: Google has released official documentation for Gemini 3.7 Flash, their newest high-speed AI model optimized for low latency and reasoning. Developers can access and integrate it through the Gemini API.

items.title: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
items.why: This template makes it simple for you to build and deploy your own full-stack AI chatbot web applications.
items.summary: Created by the shadcn team, this project is a starter template for building AI chatbots using Next.js and the Vercel AI SDK. It includes ready-to-use user interface components and API configurations.

items.title: Show HN: MCP Memory – Fast Agent Memory Using Google's OKF and SQLite FTS5
items.why: It offers a practical open-source solution for giving persistent memory to your AI agents using simple database tools.
items.summary: MCP Memory is an open-source tool that provides fast persistent memory for AI agents using SQLite full-text search. It connects via the Model Context Protocol to help agents store and retrieve interaction history.

items.title: 0xnyn/airship
items.why: It provides a visual, Figma-like editor interface to manage and interact with coding AI agents.
items.summary: Airship is a visual interface built for AI coding tools like Claude Code and OpenCode. It allows developers to inspect and edit code visually while interacting with coding assistants.

items.title: ShawnPana/phone-harness
items.why: It allows you to experiment with AI agents that can directly interact with and automate mobile phone actions.
items.summary: Phone Harness is an open-source tool that lets AI agents control smartphone functions and perform mobile tasks. It bridges LLM reasoning with mobile device automation.

items.title: antirez/h3.c
items.why: It is an open-source local AI engine written in concise C by one of the tech world's most famous developers.
items.summary: Created by Redis creator Salvatore Sanfilippo, h3.c is a lightweight C implementation for running MiniMax H3 AI models natively on Mac hardware. It demonstrates high-performance local LLM execution without heavy dependencies.

items.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
items.why: This official repository gives you a modular framework for building customizable AI plugins and agent workflows.
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source modular framework designed to let developers extend AI agent capabilities using plugins. It offers a structured way to build and connect custom tools to DeepSeek models.

items.title: SaladDay/pi-from-scratch
items.why: It is a beginner-friendly project that helps you understand how AI agents work under the hood by building one yourself.
items.summary: This repository provides a minimal 600-line TypeScript implementation of an AI agent framework. It serves as a step-by-step educational guide to understanding agent design from scratch.

items.title: Leutenegger/book-to-skill
items.why: It helps you turn textbook material into custom context that Claude Code can directly query while you learn to program.
items.summary: Book-to-Skill is an open-source tool that converts technical PDF books into structured knowledge modules for Claude Code. It allows your AI coding assistant to reference specific textbook chapters while you study or program.

items.title: Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
items.why: It showcases a new student-founded startup building AI coding tools, offering inspiration and industry insight.
items.summary: Bullet is a Y Combinator startup creating a high-speed AI coding agent built by recent college graduates. The founders share their launch story and discuss speed optimizations for autonomous coding assistants.

items.title: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, different results
items.why: This practical comparison helps you see how different modern LLMs perform on the exact same programming task.
items.summary: A developer tested eleven popular AI models with a single identical prompt to compare their outputs and reasoning styles. The post breaks down key differences in model accuracy and code generation quality.

items.title: I built a 500k-domain search engine for makers in a weekend for $10
items.why: It demonstrates how you can build and launch a impressive full web project on a tiny budget using basic tools.
items.summary: A developer shares how they built a search engine indexing 500,000 domains in a single weekend for just $10. The write-up highlights efficient web indexing, minimal data architecture, and cost-effective design.

items.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
items.why: It provides important global perspective on the ongoing geopolitical developments in Ukraine.
items.summary: In an exclusive interview, Russian Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov stated that President Vladimir Putin can no longer claim a decisive military victory in Ukraine. He highlighted that the war has reached a standstill where total conquest is unachievable.

items.title: Taiwan briefly slows its mobile internet to text-only speed as part of defense drill
items.why: It covers a notable world event where national defense planning directly impacts daily digital technology usage.
items.summary: Taiwan temporarily throttled its mobile internet infrastructure to text-only speeds during a defense exercise. The drill tested network resilience and emergency communications amid geopolitical tensions with China.
